coding.description: Architecture, supervision, and delivery; direct work or delegation by judgment

models.guidance: Preferred main coding model and the pr-reviewer and tech-lead default, via the Subs gateway. The configured models do not have overlapping provider routes, so never retry the same model through another provider. Explicit user provider/model selection determines the initial model; fallback remains automatic unless the user explicitly requires that exact model or forbids fallback. On model availability, authentication, or quota failure, inspect any partial work and automatically continue through the configured model chain using a new explicit pi-subagents launch without waiting for confirmation. Report the exact failed model, reason, and fallback model so the transition is observable. Unrelated launch/tooling/workflow failures remain infrastructure blockers under pi-subagents recovery rules. Tech-lead automatic fallback chain: Fable, then public-only Muse, then GLM 5.3, then GPT Sol via Subs. The PR skill requests independent opinions from both Astra and anthropic/claude-fable-5-1 on the same patch and criteria when available; outside that skill, Fable remains an explicit per-launch review alternative. Use tech-lead for frontier judgment checkpoints (architecture, difficult tradeoffs, contested decisions) so a cheap main session consults frontier only at high-stakes moments. Reserve for architecture, difficult reasoning, supervision, and final judgment rather than routine implementation. Main-model selection remains independent of identity activation.

Configured default for ui-design in either public or private repositories: design direction, interaction specifications, and implementation guidelines, not routine UI implementation. UI implementation belongs to general using the GLM/Muse visibility routing and following accepted design guidelines. For the PR skill, select it with an explicit per-launch override for a second independent opinion alongside Astra on the same patch and criteria when available. Outside that skill, it remains an alternative to Astra for reviews.

Default for implementation (including UI implementation) and explore-codebase in verified public repositories; explicitly select Muse for these launches. For UI implementation, follow accepted design guidelines. Verify the actual repository is public and the handoff contains no private material before using Muse by default; a remote URL alone is not evidence of public visibility. Never send private or unknown-visibility repository context to Muse by default. An explicit user instruction to use Muse overrides this default routing regardless of repository visibility; confirm the requested scope and proceed with the user's choice.

Default for implementation (including UI implementation) in private or unknown-visibility repositories. Also the configured default for general. If GLM is unavailable, authentication fails, or quota is exhausted, inspect any partial work and automatically start a new explicit pi-subagents launch with subs-codex/gpt-5.6-sol without waiting for user confirmation. Do not retry GLM or Sol through another provider; no overlapping provider routes are configured. Keep GLM as the default, and report the exact failed model, reason, and fallback model; the fallback is automatic but not silent. Unrelated launch/tooling/workflow failures remain infrastructure blockers and must not trigger this fallback or an execution-engine change. For UI implementation, follow accepted design guidelines. An explicit user instruction to use another model determines the initial model regardless of repository visibility; fallback remains automatic unless the user explicitly requires that exact model or forbids fallback.

GPT Sol is the automatic fallback from zai/glm-5.3 for subagents, including private or unknown-visibility repository work. After a GLM availability, authentication, or quota failure, inspect any partial work and automatically start a new explicit launch with subs-codex/gpt-5.6-sol without waiting for user confirmation. Do not attempt a second provider route for Sol; none is configured. Report the exact model and fallback reason so the automatic fallback is not silent. Explicit user provider/model selection determines the initial model; fallback remains automatic unless the user explicitly requires that exact model or forbids fallback. This does not replace GLM's default or change the main model.

Configured default for explore-codebase in private or unknown-visibility repositories, and for web-researcher regardless of repository visibility. For explore-codebase in verified public repositories, explicitly select Muse instead. An explicit user instruction to use Muse overrides visibility routing.
